query: What minimal forward-pass pseudo-code and unit-test specifications (including a small synthetic dataset with controlled ambiguity) will verify mean/variance propagation and calibration?

response.query: What minimal forward-pass pseudo-code and unit-test specifications (including a small synthetic dataset with controlled ambiguity) will verify mean/variance propagation and calibration?
response.answer: Pseudo-code: `mean = sum(data)/len(data); variance = sum((x-mean)**2 for x in data)/len(data)`. Unit-test: `assert abs(calculated_mean - true_mean) < epsilon; assert abs(calculated_variance - true_variance) < epsilon`. Synthetic dataset: `[1, 2, 3, 4, 5]`.
